title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. translated_title: SecureGARD：面向安全工具使用型LLM代理的动态本体引导治理框架
translated_abstract: 使用工具的大型语言模型（LLM）代理会将模型输出转化为具有实际影响的行动，从而使间接提示注入演变为一个执行安全问题。现有的防御方法通过约束工具调用、轨迹或信息流来进行防护，但往往将动作语义、状态依赖关系和证据关系保持为隐式状态，这限制了在异构工具之间的泛化能力，并使安全更新变得复杂。我们提出了SecureGARD，一个动态本体引导的治理框架。SecureGARD将异构调用锚定在共享的语义表示中，并将可执行本体与回合级任务状态相结合，以推导出确定性的就绪、等待和禁止三类决策。等待决策识别出未满足但可恢复的义务，从而实现有界重规划，而不会扩大代理的授权边界。SecureGARD从经过验证的训练执行中离线演化其本体。离线LLM提出与具体实例无关的……
tldr: 提出SecureGARD框架，通过将可执行本体与回合级任务状态相结合，为工具使用型LLM代理生成确定性的就绪、等待和禁止决策，从而抵御间接提示注入攻击，同时在不扩大授权边界的前提下支持有界重规划。
en_tdlr: SecureGARD is a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework that derives deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions for tool-using LLM agents by combining an executable ontology with episode-level task state, mitigating indirect prompt injection while enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary.
